ऋक्थ ऋक्थ, अम्, n. (fr. rt. रिच्), property,
wealth, possessions, effects (especially left at death);
gold; see रिक्थ.
—ऋक्थ-ग्रहण, अम्, n. re-
ceiving or inheriting property.
—ऋक्थ-ग्राह, अस्,
आ, अम्, an inheritor or receiver of property; (अस्),
m. inheriting or receiving property.
—ऋक्थ-जात,
अस्, आ, अम्, formed into property, accumulated (as
property).
—ऋक्थ-भाग, अस्, m. division of pro-
perty, inheritance, partition, a share.
—ऋक्थ-भा-
गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, an heir, a coheir; inheriting or sharing
property.
—ऋक्थ-हर, अस्, ई, अम्, an heir, a co-
heir.
—ऋक्थ-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, inheriting or sharing
property; an heir.
—ऋक्थादान (˚थ-आद्˚), अस्,
m. an inheritor.
